title: 第257章 好好掂量第256章 白衣覆面
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：灵石仙族第七卷：天海竞逐第257章好好掂量（..la）事后四名苍龙老祖之所以会形神受创，甚至出现境界不涨反退的情况，也是因邪法被剥离后的反噬所致。
他们在这几年里可是没少通过这门邪法进行悟道，并借助其力量增长自身修为。
如今这邪法与自身的联系，被杨灵睿一道判令斩断，隐藏在他们体内的那些祸根便也提前爆发了出来。
也就是陈怀安和萧瑶在古墓内发现了苍龙气息，随后新天修士的反应也足够及时，不然若叫这些个老龙们再修炼个几年，等到邪法与身魂高度融合、因果纠缠过重，就算是杨灵睿本尊到场，也是回天乏术了。
现在四名苍龙老祖虽然个个伤势不轻，还都有不同程度的跌境，但这样的结果对他们来说却绝对算不上坏事。
通过这场剧烈的反噬，他们体内的邪法遗毒便也随着那些散落的血水与碎鳞一道，被排出了大半。
之后的些许残余也可通过日常的修炼进行消解，接下来只要再好生静养修补个几十年，他们便能够再度恢复到原有的境界，并将那份邪法的影响彻底扫清。
从最终的结果来看，这次杨灵睿的出手可不只是挽救了四名苍龙老祖的道途，更是挽救了整个苍龙族群，让他们能够就此免于邪法的侵蚀。
但此事对于尚不曾知晓邪法之祸的苍龙族修士来说，便正如那位苍龙老祖所言，是杨灵睿恶意出手，阻了他们的道途，断了他们的前程。
在今日之前，四名苍龙老祖还都沉浸在几百年后踏虚登天的美梦之中，皆是为苍龙族以后光明的未来感到欣喜。
但这一切的美好愿景，却都在今日戛然而止，被西北杨氏的这位沧澜命官给蛮横无理的撕碎。
面对此等剧变，四位苍龙老祖心中的怒火与怨恨之意是何等深重，便也可想而知了。
“诸位前辈莫要动怒，且先听我一言可好？”
也是感受到了四只老龙身上逐渐上涌的杀意，夜沉锋便是持剑而起，挡在了杨灵睿这道魂体之前。
“夜沉锋！我苍龙一族对你灵霄道院那般信任，甚至破例让你带杨氏之人进入族地，没想到你等竟对我族包藏祸心，行下如此歹毒之事！”
“哼！听你一言？事已至此，他杨灵睿做了什么，我族修士都看得一清二楚，我等身上的这些伤口，也还在流着血呢！还有什么好说的！？”
“念在你是庄院主的徒弟，我等可以放你离去，此事也不做追究，但他杨灵睿！还有此番进入我苍龙族地的所有杨氏修士，都必须留在此处，为自己的所作所为付出代价！”
四名苍龙老祖此刻正处于火气上头的时候，即便夜沉锋想要出面劝说，也没法立刻让他们平复心境。
场间的氛围也在四名苍龙老祖逐渐外显的真玄之下，变得愈发紧绷了起来。
这四只老龙中修为最高的一个，都已经来到了洞玄后期的大尊之境，若他们真是铁了心的要对杨氏修士下手，仅凭夜沉锋一人可是根本拦不下来的。

也就是因为夜沉锋此刻挡在了前头，不然杨元鸿和杨灵睿的这道魂体，便都得被四只老龙生吞活剥了才是。
不过他们一行人能来到苍龙族地，对于可能发生的各类状况，必然也是都做好了预案，并准备了相应的对策。
眼下面对怒意难消的苍龙老祖，夜沉锋明白单纯的劝说并不会起效果，若想要让这些老龙冷静下来，并相信之后几人的说辞，便还需要再借助一份外力才行。
而要说苍龙一族最怕的是什么，那便是当属自己那位已经登天而走的师尊无疑。
所以想让这些蠢蠢欲动的老龙冷静下来，第一步就是要让他们回想起这份埋藏在灵魂深处的恐惧。
于是在听过四只老龙的咆哮后，夜沉锋便也没急着与他们多说什么，而是默默地从袖中取出了一件宝盒，而后让出一个身位，将这件宝盒飘悬在了杨灵睿身前。
见此情景，四只苍龙老祖以及禁地中的其他苍龙族真意修士，皆是生出几分疑惑之念，不知道这夜沉锋与杨氏修士又是要唱哪一出。
但当杨灵睿的魂体逐渐与这件宝盒产生共鸣，并慢慢将其打开，露出其中所藏之物的真容和气息之后，禁地中所有苍龙族修士便都是感到心神一滞，而后身体便开始不自觉的颤动。
庄璇玑在登天之前，于道院之内留下了九道真玄，分别对应生、杀、道、法、术、灵、念、心、神九条道相之属。
这九道真玄，并不是说庄璇玑修成了九份不同的功法，而是其功修圆满、领悟大道真谛，可以一道衍百道的象征。
之所以会有这九道真玄，也只是因为她滞留在沧澜就八百多年，除了本身的主修道途之外，这位人间第一修便是稳定的以一百年衍化一道的速度，将这余下八份真玄淬炼而成。
去除其中代表其道生之高位的本命真玄，余下八道真玄便是两两相应，为生杀、法术、灵念、心神，四条明晰的主脉。
可以说除了不修肉身之外，庄璇玑在各个方面的修行上，都已经达到了沧澜修士能够触及的顶点。
而眼下，夜沉锋所取出的这件小宝盒内，所盛放的便是其师尊所留下的那份杀道真玄。
如今此物与杨灵睿产生了共鸣，显然已经有了跃跃欲试的认主之相。
虽然杨灵睿本身境界不高，对四名苍龙老祖并无实质性的威胁。
但这道真玄可是确确实实的出自那位庄院主之手，其中所蕴威能之盛，他们光是这么远远看着就有了几分毛骨悚然之意，心中同样是充满了忌惮。
“此物...可是庄院主，在此界的遗存之物？”
在见到这份杀道真玄后，四只老龙明显冷静了不少，其中那位苍龙族大尊者也是压低了声量向夜沉锋询问着。
夜沉锋闻言便也露出了一抹笑意，点头道：“不错，此物正是我家师尊所留，也能代表师尊的意志，而正如诸位所见，这道真玄已经认定了灵睿为主，若诸位依旧心有所执，要对灵睿出手，那可就得好好掂量一番，违抗我家师尊的意志，会是什么后果了。”..la
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Volume 7 of the Lingshi Immortal Clan: The Competition between the Sky and the Sea, Chapter 257, Think carefully (..la) The reason why the four Canglong Ancestors suffered physical and mental injuries after the incident, and even declined in their realms instead of rising, was also due to the backlash after the evil magic was stripped away.
In the past few years, they have achieved enlightenment through this evil method and used its power to increase their cultivation.
Now that the connection between this evil method and themselves was cut off by Yang Lingrui's decree, the evil hidden in their bodies also exploded in advance.
That is to say, Chen Huaian and Xiao Yao discovered the aura of the blue dragon in the ancient tomb, and the response of the Xintian monks was timely enough. Otherwise, if these old dragons were asked to practice for a few more years, when the evil magic was highly integrated with the body and soul, and the cause and effect were too entangled, even if Yang Lingrui himself was present, there would be no way to save the day.
Although the four Canglong Ancestors are now seriously injured and have fallen to varying degrees, this result is definitely not a bad thing for them.
Through this violent backlash, most of the evil poison in their bodies was expelled along with the scattered blood and broken scales.
The remaining remnants can be eliminated through daily practice. As long as they rest and repair for a few decades, they can return to their original state and completely eliminate the influence of the evil law.
Judging from the final result, Yang Lingrui's action not only saved the path of the four Canglong Ancestors, but also saved the entire Canglong ethnic group, allowing them to avoid the erosion of evil laws.
But for the monks of the Canglong tribe who have not yet known the disaster of evil, this matter is just like what the ancestor of Canglong said. It was Yang Lingrui who maliciously blocked their path and ruined their future.
Before today, the four Canglong ancestors were still immersed in the dream of reaching heaven in a few hundred years, and they were all happy for the bright future of the Canglong clan.
But all the beautiful visions came to an abrupt end today, being torn to pieces arbitrarily and unreasonably by the Canglan official of the Yang family in the northwest.
Faced with such drastic changes, one can imagine how deep the anger and resentment in the hearts of the four Canglong Ancestors were.
"Seniors, please don't get angry and just listen to me first, okay?"
Feeling the killing intent gradually rising from the four old dragons, Ye Chenfeng stood up with his sword and blocked Yang Lingrui's soul.
"Ye Chenfeng! I, the Canglong Clan, trust you so much at Lingxiao Taoist Academy, and even made an exception to allow you to bring people from the Yang family into the clan's territory. I didn't expect that you and others would harbor evil intentions towards our clan and do such vicious things!"
"Hmph! Listen to what you said? Now that the matter is over, our monks can clearly see what Yang Lingrui has done. The wounds on our bodies are still bleeding! What else is there to say!?"
"Since you are the disciple of the master of the village, we can let you go without any further investigation, but Yang Lingrui! And all the Yang monks who entered our Canglong Clan this time must stay here and pay the price for what they have done!"
When the four Canglong Ancestors were in a state of anger, even if Ye Chenfeng wanted to come forward to persuade them, he could not calm them down immediately.
The atmosphere in the field also became increasingly tense as the four Canglong Ancestors gradually revealed their true mysteries.
The one with the highest cultivation level among these four old dragons has already reached the realm of Great Master in the late Dongxuan period. If they are really determined to attack the Yang monks, Ye Chenfeng alone cannot stop them at all.
It was because Ye Chenfeng was blocking the front at this moment, otherwise the souls of Yang Yuanhong and Yang Lingrui would have been eaten alive by the four old dragons.
However, when they came to the Canglong tribe, they must have made plans for various situations that might occur and prepared corresponding countermeasures.
Now facing the angry Ancestor Canglong, Ye Chenfeng understoodMere persuasion will not be effective. If you want to calm down these old dragons and believe what they say next, you will need to rely on external force.
As for what the Canglong clan is most afraid of, it is undoubtedly their master who has ascended to heaven and left.
So if you want to calm down these old dragons who are ready to act, the first step is to remind them of the fear buried deep in their souls.
So after hearing the roars of the four old dragons, Ye Chenfeng was not in a hurry to say anything to them. Instead, he silently took out a treasure box from his sleeve, then gave up his position and hung the treasure box in front of Yang Lingrui.
Seeing this scene, the four Canglong Ancestors and the other Canglong Clan True Meaning monks in the forbidden area all had some doubts. They didn't know what Shen Feng and the Yang monks were going to sing that night.
But when Yang Lingrui's soul gradually resonated with the treasure box and slowly opened it, revealing the true appearance and breath of the things hidden inside, all the Canglong monks in the forbidden area felt their minds stagnate, and then their bodies began to tremble unconsciously.
Before Zhuang Xuanji ascended to heaven, he left nine true mysteries in the Taoist courtyard, corresponding to the nine attributes of life, killing, Tao, law, technique, spirit, mind, heart, and spirit.
These nine true mysteries do not mean that Zhuang Xuanji has mastered nine different techniques, but it is a symbol that he has perfected his skills and comprehended the true meaning of the Dao, and can develop hundreds of Dao together.
The reason why there are these nine true mysteries is just because she has stayed in Canglan for more than eight hundred years. In addition to her own main path, this first cultivator in the world has steadily refined the remaining eight true mysteries at the speed of one hundred years.
After excluding the natal true mystery that represents his high position in Taoism, the remaining eight true mysteries are corresponding in pairs, which are the four clear main channels of life and death, magic, spiritual thoughts, and mind.
It can be said that except for not cultivating the physical body, Zhuang Xuanji's cultivation in all aspects has reached the pinnacle that monk Canglan can reach.
And now, the small treasure box that Ye Chenfeng took out contained the true secret of the way of killing left by his master.
Now this object resonates with Yang Lingrui, and it is obvious that he is eager to recognize its owner.
Although Yang Lingrui himself was not at a high level, he did not pose a substantial threat to the four Canglong Ancestors.
But this true mystery was definitely made by the master of the village, and the power contained in it was so powerful that they felt a bit creepy just looking at it from such a distance, and their hearts were also filled with fear.
"This thing... is the remnant of the village master in this world?"
After seeing this true secret of killing, the four old dragons obviously calmed down a lot. Among them, the great master of the Canglong tribe lowered his voice and asked Ye Chenfeng.
Ye Chenfeng also showed a smile when he heard this, nodded and said: "Yes, this thing was left by my master, and it can also represent the master's will. As you can see, this Zhenxuan has identified Lingrui as the master. If you are still determined and want to take action against Lingrui, then you have to carefully consider the consequences of disobeying my master's will."..la
